title: A walkable ASCII cyberpunk city in one HTML file [video]
summary: A pure HTML/JavaScript project that renders a walkable 3D cyberpunk city using only ASCII characters, with updates adding traffic systems, interior spaces, and varying building heights.
problem_solved: Demonstrates how to create immersive 3D environments using only text characters without external dependencies.
why_valuable: Showcases creative use of minimal web technologies and proves ASCII art can deliver visually impressive experiences.
